messages:
Elaine (CSM): Quick note — HelioHealth is showing a clear expansion signal. Over the past 48h: token volume on /generate up ~3.8x, embeddings calls up ~5x, and they created 2 new service accounts. Observed spike around 02:00 UTC yesterday.
Jordan (AE): Nice. Any clue which teams are driving it?
Elaine (CSM): Looks like a new data-ingest pipeline + analytics team. Their payloads are larger (avg seq len ~1024). I pasted a small sample they sent: `{"source":"ehr_batch","records":1200,"avg_tokens":980}`
Mike (Solutions Eng): Thanks — longer sequences + higher throughput likely means different batching/kv-cache profile. Do they use streaming?
Elaine (CSM): No streaming yet. They're doing bulk batches via our REST endpoint.
Sara (Enablement): We should line up a short enablement session for the analytics folks — focus on best-practice batching, prefix caching, and cost controls. Can do a 30m workshop.
Jordan (AE): Renewal for HelioHealth is in 11 months — good time to convert this into a Dedicated conversation if throughput keeps rising. Risk is low but we should capture an ROI projection.
Mike (Solutions Eng): I can run a quick perf/cost runbook. Need a representative request trace and their recent config (model version, max_tokens, batch_size). Elaine can you pull sample traces?
Elaine (CSM): On it — attaching a sanitized trace in #secure (copied below). Also noticed two new service accounts named `analytics_pipeline` and `ingest_worker`.
Elaine (CSM): ```trace
POST /v1/generate
model: redwood-v1-large
input_tokens: 1100
max_tokens: 400
batch_count: 180
latency_p50: 420ms
latency_p95: 1.9s
```
billing-bot: Billing alert — customer HelioHealth crossed $25k/month estimated billing threshold yesterday.
Jordan (AE): Good catch from billing-bot. I'll reach out to the buyer with a usage update and propose a short ROI doc. Elaine — please flag any cost-sensitivity notes.
Elaine (CSM): They mentioned "want predictable spend" in last sync. Also asked about auto-scaling Dedicated in the future.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Proposal: 1) temporary burst policy to smooth ingestion spikes 2) recommend a quantization profile for redwood-v1-large to cut token cost ~18% 3) run an A/B on batch_size 80 vs 160 for throughput. I can prototype on our staging cluster by EOD tomorrow.
Sara (Enablement): I'll prep a 30m workshop deck (how batching & cache affect latency/cost) and a one-pager for their infra team. Can we slot it next Tue?
Jordan (AE): Tues works for HelioHealth. I'll invite the buyer + infra lead. Elaine, loop them in and ask for sample traffic pattern so Mike's runbook matches production.
Elaine (CSM): Looping in Helio contact tomorrow, will ask for traffic samples and confirm attendees for Tue.
Mike (Solutions Eng): If we get traffic samples, I'll simulate and share expected cost delta and perf curves. Tag me when samples arrive.
Elaine (CSM): One more ask — capture enablement feedback after the session and any feature asks (e.g., per-route caching TTL). We should log that in Gainsight ticket GH-4521.
Sara (Enablement): Will do. I'll add a short survey form for the analytics engineers after the workshop.
Jordan (AE): Long-term play: if their usage pattern stabilizes, propose Dedicated reserved pool + a committed spend that lowers unit price. I'll draft a strawman for the buyer after we have Mike's numbers.
Elaine (CSM): Great. Summary of next steps: 1) Elaine — request traffic traces + confirm Tue attendees (by EOD today) 2) Mike — perf/cost prototype (by EOD tomorrow) 3) Sara — workshop materials + survey (by Mon) 4) Jordan — prepare ROI/dedicated strawman after Mike's results.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Ack.
Sara (Enablement): Ack, prepping slide deck.
Jordan (AE): I'll draft outreach email to buyer and infra lead.
Elaine (CSM): Thread closed once traces arrive. I'll update GH-4521 with the signals we observed (volume spike, new service accounts, billing threshold). :+1:
